title: Welcome
sdk_landing_headline: A unified engineering foundation to accelerate building and launching Tawakkalna digital services
sdk_landing_subtitle: Start integrating your service with Tawakkalna. Download the Tawakkalna SDK and launch your services with a simple, fast integration.
sdk_landing_statement: From building every service from scratch, to building services on a unified engineering foundation ready to scale.
sdk_landing_why_fw_intro: As Tawakkalna digital services expand, engineering effort should not grow at the same rate as the number of services. The framework turns shared engineering capabilities from repeated work in every project into a unified foundation reusable across services.
sdk_landing_why_fw_card1_body: Less time spent setting up projects and rebuilding shared technical capabilities from scratch.
sdk_landing_why_fw_card2_body: Enable teams to focus on service logic and value instead of re-implementing the technical foundation.
sdk_landing_why_fw_card3_body: Apply consistent engineering practices and standards across Tawakkalna services.
sdk_landing_why_fw_card4_body: Support growth in services without a matching growth in complexity and engineering effort.
sdk_landing_business_national_body: Tawakkalna services may connect to targets that go beyond a single project, department, or entity. So the faster we can accelerate integration and launch, the better we can support national targets and priority services.
sdk_landing_business_national_flag_alt: Flag of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
sdk_landing_align_main: The Tawakkalna Framework supports the Technology Strategy toward an exceptional digital experience and higher developer productivity through reuse, automation, unified engineering practices, and shorter time to market.
sdk_landing_align_card1_body: A unified engineering foundation helps deliver a more consistent, higher-quality experience across Tawakkalna services.
sdk_landing_align_card2_body: Reduce repeated work and let developers start from a ready engineering foundation.
sdk_landing_align_card3_body: Reuse shared capabilities and components instead of rebuilding them in every service.
sdk_landing_align_card4_body: Create a foundation that can scale, evolve, and add new capabilities in an organized way.
sdk_landing_value_title: From technical framework to measurable value
sdk_landing_value_subtitle: Framework success is not measured by how many components were built, but by the impact on the service development lifecycle.
sdk_landing_value_statement: The framework is not the goal itself—it is an engineering enabler for faster, higher-quality, more efficient digital service development.
sdk_landing_journey_title: How does the framework change the service journey?
sdk_landing_journey_highlight: Less time on foundations, more time on service value.
sdk_landing_reuse_intro: The framework enables reuse across the full service development lifecycle—not only visual components.
sdk_landing_reuse_statement: Every shared capability we reuse is time and effort we do not need to reinvest in the next service.
sdk_landing_dx_title: A better developer experience means a better user experience
sdk_landing_dx_body: When developers get a clear, unified, pre-tested foundation, less time is spent on recurring problems and more focus goes to service quality and user experience.
sdk_landing_metrics_card5_body: Services targeted to adopt the framework by 2027
sdk_landing_metrics_card6_body: Share of services aligned with framework standards
sdk_landing_metrics_note: Estimated figures for comparison and guidance. Actual baselines will be set from current services, then 2027 targets will be updated based on measured results.
sdk_landing_scale_main: Our goal is for Tawakkalna’s ability to launch digital services to grow faster than the engineering effort and cost required to build them.
sdk_landing_scale_statement: Every new service should benefit from what was built before it, and add value the next services can reuse.
sdk_landing_tech_intro: After the strategic value, development teams can explore the reusable engineering capabilities inside the framework.
sdk_landing_what_is_body: Tawakkalna SDK is a unified development package that helps teams build and connect their services to Tawakkalna faster and more easily, by providing the shared functions and integrations services need instead of rebuilding them from scratch in every project.
sdk_landing_why_body: As more services connect to Tawakkalna, many setup, integration, and technical challenges repeat across projects. This SDK turns past experience into a shared, reusable foundation so every new service benefits from what earlier services already built and learned.
sdk_landing_offers_body: The SDK provides a ready foundation for Tawakkalna integration, including user and device data, connection settings, shared functions, and core integration requirements, with future expansion for multiple test environments, payments, and other shared integrations.
sdk_landing_audience_body: It serves development teams, product teams, and organizations launching services through Tawakkalna, helping them start from a ready, proven foundation instead of starting from scratch with every service.
sdk_landing_vision_title: From a framework to a lasting engineering capability
sdk_landing_vision_body: The Tawakkalna Framework is a foundation that can evolve as services and needs grow—so new capabilities, standards, and tools can be added later and provided to services in a unified way.
sdk_landing_vision_stage3_body: Raise the intelligence and efficiency of the development lifecycle
sdk_landing_closing_title: Build once. Benefit in every service.
sdk_landing_closing_body: The Tawakkalna Framework turns accumulated engineering knowledge and capabilities into a shared foundation that helps teams deliver more services, with more consistent quality, in less time.
sdk_landing_quick_step_1: Clone the SDK from Bitbucket, or download it as a zip file.
sdk_landing_quick_step_2: Copy twk-sdk.ts into your project, and put twkhelper.js in a static folder such as assets.
sdk_landing_env_body: Your app sets the API URL before loading twkhelper.js. This keeps every Tawakkalna request working correctly.
sdk_landing_env_apibase: The base URL for the Tawakkalna API.
sdk_landing_env_enablelog: Turn logging on when you need it (optional).
sdk_landing_appearance_body_1: The Angular sample reads appearance and language from TWK.getDeviceInfo() and applies dark or light mode automatically.
sdk_landing_appearance_body_2: You can use the same approach in your UI, or keep the SDK only for the connection without changing how the app looks.
sdk_landing_keys_body: The Tawakkalna bridge gives you several helpers. Call them directly or through TWKSDK, depending on how much control you need.
coming_hero_body: A unified engineering foundation to accelerate building and launching Tawakkalna digital services. A reusable framework that provides shared technical capabilities to reduce repeated work, raise developer productivity, unify quality, and speed services to users.
coming_env_title: Test your service across multiple environments
coming_env_body: Run and test your service across multiple environments through the Tawakkalna SDK, and move between development, testing, and staging without changing project settings again and again.
coming_pay_body: A ready payment bridge that makes it easier to connect Tawakkalna services with Elm Payments through one reusable integration file, so you spend less time building payments for every new service.
coming_framework_body: A complete development framework that brings together the tools, components, and shared standards needed to build Tawakkalna services. The goal is one way of building services, faster launches, and less repeated work across projects.
documentation_intro: A full guide for the TWK SDK. Use it to connect your app to the Tawakkalna platform.
documentation_feature_1: Full TypeScript support with clear types
documentation_feature_4: Async API that works with Promises
documentation_feature_6: Support for V1 and V2 endpoints
documentation_installation_step2: Initialize the SDK with your settings
sdk_landing_impact_body_1: Our goal is not only less code, but faster delivery of services to Tawakkalna.
sdk_landing_impact_body_2: We aim to cut setup and integration time for new services by 50% or more, so a service moves from business readiness to launch readiness on Tawakkalna faster and more consistently.
sdk_landing_impact_body_3: Every service we launch today makes the next one faster and easier.
sdk_landing_business_intro: Tawakkalna services are growing fast, and with every new service we need to be faster and more ready. Tawakkalna SDK turns previous experience and integrations into a unified foundation that every new service can build on, instead of starting from scratch each time.
sdk_landing_business_kpi_services_label: Services built and connected to Tawakkalna
sdk_landing_business_target_label: Target reduction in setup and integration time
sdk_landing_business_target_body: We aim to reduce the time to set up and connect new services to Tawakkalna by 50% or more, by reusing shared integrations, experience, and capabilities.
sdk_landing_business_beyond_body: The value of Tawakkalna SDK is not limited to less code or easier developer work. The goal is to accelerate service delivery to Tawakkalna and raise our readiness for upcoming services and targets.
sdk_landing_business_closing: Every service we launch today makes the next one faster and easier.
coming_hero_headline: From building every service from scratch, to building on a unified engineering foundation ready to scale.
sdk_landing_framework_teaser_body: A unified engineering foundation to accelerate building and launching Tawakkalna digital services.
sdk_landing_metrics_intro: Estimated figures based on the current state without a unified framework, where launching a new service takes about one month.
